text.title: Common Tern
text.menu_sub: Fly over calm water and dip down to catch food.
text.menu_wild: There is no hunter here now.
text.intro: Steer to walk and swim. Hold Fly to take off.
text.hungry: Look for small insects in the air and near water.
text.no_food: No food nearby. Fly over the water.
text.chased: Fly away fast over the water.
text.about_looks: A pale grey and white bird with a black cap and a deeply forked tail. It has a red bill with a black tip.
text.about_food: Small fish and small sea animals. Here it eats aquatic insects.
text.about_home: Lakes and the sea. It rests on low sand near calm water, close to other terns.
text.about_young: Chicks are born far to the north in spring. They stay near the nest and eat small fish.
text.about_fact: It dives down to catch food near the top of the water.
